item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SYRUP -Many Milk-
  • 発売日: 2024-10-25
  • スコア: 7.0200000000000005/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狙われた優等生 身代わりの代償
  • 英語名: Nerawareta Yuutousei - Migawari no Daishou

别名

  • Targeted Honors Students - Sacrifice cost

あらすじ

Kirimizu Aoi wasn’t just a top student; she was also kind and compassionate, earning her the title of “model student” from both teachers and classmates. She held her childhood friend and classmate, Tsuchikasu Kenta, in high regard.

To save this friend, who was misunderstood as cheating on a retake, Aoi desperately pleaded with the teacher in charge of the exam, but was told to discuss it at home. Although she hesitated to go to a single man’s apartment, her desire to help her dear friend pushed her to follow him to his place.

あらすじ

After a certain incident, Yuuri was guided by Suzune, the goddess angel Holy Rouge to become “Angeltear”, and fight against the demons. Yuuri keeps fighting bravely to protect the peace of the human world, her friends and her loved ones. However, the demons saw through her personality, and prepared a special trap for her. After seeing how Angeltear uses up all her energy, they purposely start to contaminate males. The demons threaten her by saying that the only way to save these men is by sexually satisfying them.
